an10.108:1.1: tikicchakā bhikkhave virecanaṃ denti pittasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya semhasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya vātasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya
an10.108:1.2: atthetaṃ bhikkhave virecanaṃ netaṃ natthīti vadāmi
an10.108:1.3: tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave virecanaṃ sampajjatipi vipajjatipi
an10.108:2.1: ahañca kho bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ desissāmi yaṃ virecanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti
an10.108:2.3: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.108:3.1: katamañca taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti.
an10.108:4.2: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa viritā honti
an10.108:4.3: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.108:6.2: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa viritā honti
an10.108:6.3: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.108:6.4: idaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ virecanaṃ yaṃ virecanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati yaṃ virecanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccantīti.
